description: This Java class 'SelfLoansDataValidator' provides validation methods for self loan data operations within the Fineract project, including validation of retrieve loan requests, retrieve transaction requests, and loan application data.

classes.name: SelfLoansDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for validating self loan data requests and JSON payloads in the Fineract system.

methods.name: validateRetrieveLoan
methods.description: Validates the query parameters for retrieving a loan, checking for unsupported association parameters and 'exclude' parameter.

methods.name: validateRetrieveTransaction
methods.description: Validates the query parameters for retrieving a transaction, including template validation.

methods.name: validateLoanApplication
methods.description: Validates the JSON payload for loan application, ensuring required fields are present and valid.

methods.name: validateModifyLoanApplication
methods.description: Validates the JSON payload for modifying a loan application, with optional validation of certain fields.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfReqd
methods.description: Throws an exception if there are unsupported parameters detected.

methods.name: validateTemplate
methods.description: Checks if the request is a template request and adds 'template' to unsupported parameters if so.
